review: All 57 physical pages and 173 link annotations reviewed. No normative correction annotations are present.
granularity: One row per independently assessable paragraph obligation, conditional branch, permission or semantic aspect. Colon ordinals distinguish aspects inside a clause; they are inventory identifiers, not printed source paragraph numbers. Source pages refer to the original PDF, not its printed folios.

statuses.executed: A native model/check executes the stated aspect; stated boundaries still apply.
statuses.human: Author intent or semantic adequacy requires a person; no automatic pass is inferred.
statuses.external: Independent format, program, trust or accessibility validation is required.
statuses.absent: The identified mechanically checkable aspect is not currently implemented; no coverage is claimed.

non_requirement_pages.reason: Introduction, scope, normative references, definitions and notation; operative obligations are traced in clauses 6–8.

requirements.aspect: At least one explicit conformance declaration
requirements.justification: The caller selects the audit level; the corresponding declaration must occur in typed document XMP.

requirements.aspect: Multiple levels may coexist
requirements.justification: Declarations is a bag; the audit checks only the selected level without forbidding another.

requirements.aspect: Reuse declaration identifier
requirements.justification: Exact case-sensitive URI with slash before hash; caller-supplied claim data remains optional.

requirements.aspect: All general and reuse obligations apply
requirements.justification: A declaration or audit report is not evidence that every inherited ISO requirement is met.

requirements.aspect: Accessibility declaration identifier
requirements.justification: Exact case-sensitive URI; no declaration is added by the audit.

requirements.aspect: All general and accessibility obligations apply
requirements.justification: Full ISO 32000-2 and PDF/UA-2 conformance require independent validation and semantic evidence.

requirements.aspect: Optional PDF/UA-2 identification
requirements.justification: When typed pdfuaid properties are present they must supply part 2 and revision 2024 together; no claim is emitted automatically.

requirements.aspect: Effective PDF 2.0 file version
requirements.justification: Audit rejects an effective PDF version other than 2.0.

requirements.aspect: Every ISO 32000-2 requirement
requirements.justification: Native dictionary and graph checks do not implement a universal ISO conformance validator.

requirements.aspect: ISO/TS 32005 namespace inclusion
requirements.justification: Native qualified role resolution and explicit correction-profile containment rules apply to the managed structure tree.

requirements.aspect: Avoid every deprecated feature
requirements.justification: Deprecated annotation types are checked; a comprehensive deprecated-feature inventory across all ISO features remains external validation.

requirements.aspect: Avoid unspecified pre-PDF2 extensions
requirements.justification: The generic model can represent application extensions; their full compatibility needs an extension-aware validator.

requirements.aspect: Necessary embedded content must be accessible
requirements.justification: Whether an attachment is necessary to understand the document is an author/content decision.

requirements.aspect: Accessibility of necessary embedded documents
requirements.justification: External documents need their own applicable accessibility validation; the core does not parse their bytes.

requirements.aspect: Explicit extension declarations are permitted
requirements.justification: IsoExtensions and DeveloperExtensions represent independently selected declarations without asserting conformance.

requirements.aspect: Real content has text or equivalent and logical semantics
requirements.justification: Intended meaning and reading order cannot be recovered solely from PDF syntax.

requirements.aspect: Optional additional PDF Declarations and scopes
requirements.justification: Native declarations attach to document or object metadata; arbitrary absolute identifiers remain explicit.

requirements.aspect: Determine necessary non-PDF attachment status
requirements.justification: The audit cannot infer whether a non-PDF attachment is necessary to understand the parent document.

requirements.aspect: Appropriate accessibility declaration on necessary non-PDF attachment
requirements.justification: FileSpecification metadata and Declarations can express it; appropriateness and external-standard conformance need evidence.

requirements.aspect: Optional ISO subset conformity
requirements.justification: No PDF/A, PDF/X or PDF/UA certificate follows from building objects.

requirements.aspect: Inherited ISO2 and TS32005 obligations
requirements.justification: The requirement-level inventory distinguishes native checks from independent conformance work.

requirements.aspect: Semantically appropriate structures and attributes
requirements.justification: Constructed roles and relationships are checked; suitability for the actual content is reviewed by a person.

requirements.aspect: Real content has structure associations
requirements.justification: Managed tagged content rejects unclassified drawing/text and checks MCIDs, parent-tree bindings and object references.

requirements.aspect: Correct real-content classification and attributes
requirements.justification: The author decides which content matters and which attributes convey its meaning.

requirements.aspect: Do not split one semantic element across layout fragments
requirements.justification: Single-table/paragraph identity across pages depends on semantics rather than geometric pagination.

requirements.aspect: Non-real content explicitly marked as artifact
requirements.justification: Typed tagged content permits unassociated painting only inside an Artifact scope or a structural object association.

requirements.aspect: Logical order and artifact units/order
requirements.justification: The graph preserves explicit order; whether that order and artifact grouping convey the author's meaning remains human review.

requirements.aspect: Resolve every role to PDF17/PDF20/MathML
requirements.justification: Qualified resolver checks recognized namespaces, transitive targets and cycles.

requirements.aspect: Default namespace limited to unique PDF17 roles
requirements.justification: Mixed-tree inclusion rejects common roles left in PDF17 and WTPDF forbids Note.

requirements.aspect: No mapping within the same explicit namespace
requirements.justification: Every provided namespace role map is inspected.

requirements.aspect: Custom roles inherit target-role restrictions
requirements.justification: All native WTPDF checks use resolved role identities.

requirements.aspect: Native standard-role inclusion
requirements.justification: Source matrix and selected correction profile constrain managed parent/child relationships.

requirements.aspect: Use standard roles according to their meaning
requirements.justification: A syntactically allowed role can still be semantically wrong.

requirements.aspect: Single Document root explicitly in PDF20 namespace
requirements.justification: The root-child role and the original explicit namespace are both checked.

requirements.aspect: Use Document/DocumentFragment for imported logical units
requirements.justification: Origin, fragment boundaries and author's intent require content evidence.

requirements.aspect: Part grouping purpose
requirements.justification: Non-heading grouping semantics are not inferred from object syntax.

requirements.aspect: Article semantics and ownership of its title
requirements.justification: The author determines whether content is a self-contained article and which title belongs to it.

requirements.aspect: Section grouping and ownership of heading
requirements.justification: Semantic section and heading scope require human review.

requirements.aspect: Div may carry common properties
requirements.justification: Native attribute inheritance retains explicit grouping and class associations.

requirements.aspect: BlockQuote semantics
requirements.justification: Whether text quotes another source is a content decision.

requirements.aspect: TOC/TOCI selection and leader artifacts
requirements.justification: Identify a true contents list and distinguish its leaders from semantic text.

requirements.aspect: Every TOCI has target Ref directly or below
requirements.justification: A bottom-up descendant index checks nonempty Ref presence; references must target this structure tree.

requirements.aspect: Aside meaning and deepest related ancestor
requirements.justification: Relationship to the main flow cannot be proved mechanically.

requirements.aspect: Custom roles may map to NonStruct
requirements.justification: Qualified role mapping and descendant semantic retention remain explicit.

requirements.aspect: Paragraph identification and separation
requirements.justification: The intended paragraph boundaries and fallback semantics require human review.

requirements.aspect: Use numbered heading roles rather than H
requirements.justification: The resolved standard H role is rejected; headings are not forced to be sequential.

requirements.aspect: Heading level reflects evident content level
requirements.justification: The printed hierarchy and intended heading meaning are not inferred from typography.

requirements.aspect: Title is not a heading
requirements.justification: Role semantics are reviewed independently of dc:title metadata.

requirements.aspect: Standard Note is forbidden
requirements.justification: The resolved PDF17 Note role is rejected; an unrelated custom spelling is evaluated after role mapping.

requirements.aspect: Reciprocal FENote references
requirements.justification: When either endpoint Ref targets FENote, the other endpoint must reciprocate within the same tree.

requirements.aspect: Identify every citation and interactive note target
requirements.justification: The machine validates declared associations; identifying all real citations requires semantic review.

requirements.aspect: FENote owner and closed NoteType domain
requirements.justification: Optional NoteType is checked as Footnote, Endnote or None.

requirements.aspect: Choose appropriate note subtype
requirements.justification: The author identifies whether a note is a footnote or endnote; the attribute remains optional.

requirements.aspect: Sub represents semantic subdivision
requirements.justification: Whether a subdivision exists requires content review.

requirements.aspect: Label content and deepest semantic grouping
requirements.justification: Author intent distinguishes a real label from an artifact and associates it with the labelled content.

requirements.aspect: Span use satisfies all inline semantic conditions
requirements.justification: The graph cannot infer whether a more appropriate semantic inline role exists.

requirements.aspect: Quote is an actual inline quotation
requirements.justification: Quotation marks alone are not evidence of a quote.

requirements.aspect: Em/Strong represent emphasis
requirements.justification: Styling and semantic emphasis are not equivalent.

requirements.aspect: Link annotation parent is Link or Reference
requirements.justification: Native annotation-parent role checks use qualified role resolution.

requirements.aspect: Separate different link targets and group a single semantic link
requirements.justification: Target syntax can be compared, but semantic identity of split links and URL interpretation need author context.

requirements.aspect: Annot follows annotation mechanism requirements
requirements.justification: Native markup roles, flags, Popup, alternative text and tab-order checks apply.

requirements.aspect: Form follows form mechanism requirements
requirements.justification: Widget count/role, non-interactive PrintField and described action checks apply.

requirements.aspect: Ruby has exactly RB/RT or RB/RP/RT/RP
requirements.justification: The WTPDF-specific check also rejects an empty Ruby accepted as an incomplete ISO builder.

requirements.aspect: Ruby purpose, atomic grouping and restored omitted annotation text
requirements.justification: Visual ruby matching, semantic units and ActualText completeness require content/language evidence.

requirements.aspect: Warichu sequence WP/WT/WP
requirements.justification: Exact resolved child ordering is checked.

requirements.aspect: Warichu purpose and delimiter content
requirements.justification: A machine cannot infer typesetting intent or delimiter semantics solely from role names.

requirements.aspect: Labelled lists require explicit non-None ListNumbering
requirements.justification: Native attributes/classes are resolved without accepting normative defaults as explicit data.

requirements.aspect: LI real content is within Lbl or LBody
requirements.justification: Allowed transparent/artifact structure wrappers retain explicit containment validation.

requirements.aspect: Identify list labels and intended numbering scheme
requirements.justification: Presence is checked; correctness of labels and nearest scheme require semantic review.

requirements.aspect: ContinuedFrom needs ContinuedList=true and a valid list ID
requirements.justification: Present IDs resolve to another L; cycles and self-references are rejected.

requirements.aspect: Recognize all continued list segments
requirements.justification: An omitted continuation relationship cannot be inferred from typography alone.

requirements.aspect: Known segments require complete Ref associations
requirements.justification: Reuse requires Ref on first and later segments; any present Ref must identify all other known linked segments, with a cumulative budget.

requirements.aspect: Regular logical table and row-group grids
requirements.justification: Bounded row/column span expansion checks width, overlap and row-group crossing.

requirements.aspect: Explicit Headers identifiers target TH in the same table
requirements.justification: Cross-table, TD and absent identifiers are rejected.

requirements.aspect: Complete header applicability and necessary Scope/Headers
requirements.justification: Semantic header relationships and adequacy of the ISO default algorithm remain human evidence, not a false complete-table assertion.

requirements.aspect: Caption is first or last child of its group
requirements.justification: Native resolved caption ordering is checked.

requirements.aspect: Caption content, group and intended reading position
requirements.justification: The machine does not infer what content captions or whether before/after conveys the author's meaning.

requirements.aspect: Figure includes all appearance content and meaningful substructure
requirements.justification: Visual completeness and semantic unit identity need rendering/content review.

requirements.aspect: Accessibility Figure has Alt or ActualText
requirements.justification: Native role properties are checked without requiring the optional reuse recommendation.

requirements.aspect: ActualText Figure has semantically appropriate block context
requirements.justification: Native containment alone does not determine semantic appropriateness of a surrounding block.

requirements.aspect: MathML math root occurs under Formula
requirements.justification: Namespace-aware TS32005 inclusion enforces the root relationship.

requirements.aspect: Mathematical expressions use valid presentation MathML
requirements.justification: Recognizing MathML namespace objects is not a presentation-MathML grammar or mathematical-equivalence validator.

requirements.aspect: Declared MathML associated representation has Supplement relationship
requirements.justification: Formula AF entries with application/mathml+xml MIME require Supplement; identifying MathML in arbitrary generic XML remains external parsing.

requirements.aspect: Accessible nonmathematical Formula has Alt or ActualText
requirements.justification: Native Formula property presence is checked.

requirements.aspect: Scientific formula semantic role and appropriate representation
requirements.justification: Determining mathematical versus other scientific meaning and suitable external representation needs author review.

requirements.aspect: Index grouping and references represent actual indexed content
requirements.justification: Multiple index purposes, topics and referenced ranges require content interpretation.

requirements.aspect: BibEntry meaning and bibliography ARIA purpose
requirements.justification: Identifying bibliographic content and the containing Sect's purpose is semantic.

requirements.aspect: Code meaning and textual equivalent
requirements.justification: The author decides what constitutes code and whether its representation preserves intended text.

requirements.aspect: Artifact uses native artifact mechanism
requirements.justification: The tagged content validator and standard artifact attributes apply.

requirements.aspect: Explicit standard/custom attribute ownership
requirements.justification: StructureAttributeObject checks O versus NS; standard domains validate values and required entries.

requirements.aspect: Layout attributes convey all semantically significant properties
requirements.justification: Whether color, layout or contrast conveys meaning cannot be inferred from a dictionary.

requirements.aspect: Table/List/PrintField/Artifact attribute shapes
requirements.justification: Native standard attribute objects validate applicable domains; WTPDF adds list/table/Form checks.

requirements.aspect: Use all attributes appropriate to the real content
requirements.justification: Required semantic attributes are content-dependent even when a shape is valid.

requirements.aspect: ARIA semantic appropriateness and noncontradiction
requirements.justification: Role intent and additional states/properties require author/content review.

requirements.aspect: ARIA and DPUB-ARIA attributes use ARIA-1.1 owner
requirements.justification: Explicit O=ARIA-1.1 construction is supported. An arbitrary extension role key does not prove ARIA intent; external author/schema evidence is required before interpreting generic custom attributes as ARIA.

requirements.aspect: Non-real paint is explicitly artifact-marked
requirements.justification: Managed tagged content checks the classification boundary on typed painting operations.

requirements.aspect: Artifact property lists or attributes convey relevant semantics
requirements.justification: Choosing Type/Subtype/BBox based on the actual artifact needs content evidence.

requirements.aspect: Context-dependent artifacts remain in Artifact structure elements
requirements.justification: Determining whether an artifact only makes sense beside tree content is an author decision.

requirements.aspect: All text is programmatically determinable
requirements.justification: Typed mappings are checked; arbitrary font programs, generic CMaps and opaque content require independent parsing.

requirements.aspect: PUA used only when no public Unicode value exists
requirements.justification: A private-use codepoint is not by itself evidence that a public alternative exists.

requirements.aspect: ActualText restores the intended Unicode sequence
requirements.justification: The needed semantic replacement cannot be proved from codepoints alone.

requirements.aspect: Accessibility PUA real text has Alt/ActualText
requirements.justification: Actual shown native ToUnicode sequences are checked against inline/ancestor alternatives and Artifact scopes; reuse remains a recommendation.

requirements.aspect: Catalog Lang is nonempty and explicit overrides are nonempty
requirements.justification: Direct/indirect text strings are decoded; an empty override does not inherit silently.

requirements.aspect: Language matches every content/string and change
requirements.justification: Specific language, correct changes and in-string language escapes require linguistic evidence.

requirements.aspect: Rendering-mode exemption is exact
requirements.justification: Tr3 alone exempts visual embedding; q/Q, gs, Tf, Form invocations and text-showing operators carry actual state.

requirements.aspect: Every font/program meets its font specification
requirements.justification: The core does not parse external font formats; independent font modules validate their explicitly supported formats.

requirements.aspect: Embedded composite CIDSystemInfo agrees
requirements.justification: Registry/Ordering equality and sufficient Supplement are checked; Identity-H/V are exempt.

requirements.aspect: Non-Identity predefined CMap collection agreement
requirements.justification: The external predefined CMap registry/order/supplement must be supplied or independently validated.

requirements.aspect: Embedded CIDFontType2 has CIDToGIDMap
requirements.justification: A stream or Identity is required.

requirements.aspect: Nonstandard encoding CMaps are embedded and bases standard
requirements.justification: Encoding and typed ToUnicode base relationships are checked; predefined names use the exact enum.

requirements.aspect: Generic CMap WMode matches program
requirements.justification: Native EncodingCMap constructs both consistently; opaque program text requires an independent CMap parser.

requirements.aspect: Rendered fonts require an embedded program
requirements.justification: Actual typed text-showing operations distinguish Tr3 from rendered text; Type3 is intrinsically embedded.

requirements.aspect: Embedding legality and complete rendered glyph programs
requirements.justification: Program embedding rights and actual glyph definitions require the independent font parser and license evidence.

requirements.aspect: Permitted subsets remain conformant
requirements.justification: Subset construction and complete font-format validation are separate processors.

requirements.aspect: Widths and vertical metrics agree within 1/1000 unit
requirements.justification: External font-program metrics require independent parsing; the example oracle checks its actual TrueType widths.

requirements.aspect: TrueType dictionary symbolic/nonsymbolic Encoding rules
requirements.justification: Actual used font descriptor flags constrain allowed Encoding/BaseEncoding or its omission.

requirements.aspect: Required cmap subtables, Adobe glyph names and actual glyph selection
requirements.justification: External font tables and Adobe Glyph List membership require independent font data.

requirements.aspect: Native ToUnicode maps every shown code and forbids zero/BOM/noncharacter
requirements.justification: Typed code spaces and mappings are checked with cumulative mapping and text-byte budgets.

requirements.aspect: Generic CMap and glyph-name exemptions fully cover every shown glyph
requirements.justification: The audit reports explicit external evidence requirements instead of silently assuming a mapping.

requirements.aspect: No native Type0 .notdef CID/GID use
requirements.justification: Native decoding rejects unmapped codes, CID zero and zero/absent glyph indices in typed maps regardless of Tr.

requirements.aspect: No .notdef across every external font/CMap format
requirements.justification: Simple-font programs and external predefined data need independent glyph resolution.

requirements.aspect: Nontext semantics use Figure/Formula or equivalent
requirements.justification: Visual drawing type does not determine its semantic type.

requirements.aspect: Nontext representations intended as text have ActualText and proper context
requirements.justification: Knowing that a vector or image should be consumed as text requires author intent and rendered-content review.

requirements.aspect: Human-readable PDF text strings exclude PUA
requirements.justification: Typed TextString and known raw/indirect text fields, including marked-content alternatives, are checked.

requirements.aspect: Accessible optional-content configurations have Name and no AS
requirements.justification: Default and nondefault configurations are checked, with Name conditional on nonempty Configs.

requirements.aspect: Every internal destination is structural
requirements.justification: Internal GoTo actions, OpenAction, named destinations, outline and Link targets require SD or a named destination carrying SD. Ordered K traversal resolves the first actual content page, skips empty Pg-only nodes and falls back to the document's first page; D remains an independent required page destination. Semantic adequacy and completeness of cross-references remain human review.

requirements.aspect: Declared Ref endpoints stay within this tree
requirements.justification: Direct or indirect Ref arrays contain only indirect members of this native structure tree.

requirements.aspect: All actionable cross-references identify actual targets
requirements.justification: The semantic presence and completeness of content references need author review.

requirements.aspect: Deprecated annotation subtypes absent
requirements.justification: Sound, Movie and TrapNet are rejected; custom subtypes still receive general checks.

requirements.aspect: Annotation objects have unique structural associations
requirements.justification: Managed OBJR/StructParent validation checks ownership, page presence and duplicate bindings.

requirements.aspect: No marked substructure of annotation appearance streams
requirements.justification: Only actual AP stream identities/states attached to the owner are classified as appearance, not arbitrary Form owners.

requirements.aspect: Choose semantically appropriate annotation inclusion/role
requirements.justification: A visible annotation may intentionally be an untagged artifact, so omission alone is not an automatic failure.

requirements.aspect: Invisible or NoView-without-Toggle annotations are artifacts
requirements.justification: Indirect flags are resolved; a structurally included artifact must have Artifact role.

requirements.aspect: Markup annotations use Annot when real content
requirements.justification: The enumerated markup types, plus Watermark/Projection, have a resolved Annot parent.

requirements.aspect: Context is adequate or Contents supplies purpose
requirements.justification: The need for a description depends on context; RC and Contents equivalence requires rich-text interpretation.

requirements.aspect: Text annotation context and Name reflect intent
requirements.justification: The displayed note purpose is content-dependent.

requirements.aspect: Link context and contiguous reading-order content
requirements.justification: Actual logical scope and meaning of a link require semantic review.

requirements.aspect: FreeText callout reading order matches origin
requirements.justification: Callout geometry and intended order require content review.

requirements.aspect: Line/shape annotation markup rules
requirements.justification: Native markup-role checks apply.

requirements.aspect: Split noncontiguous text markup appropriately
requirements.justification: Whether content is logically contiguous is semantic.

requirements.aspect: Caret markup rules
requirements.justification: Native markup-role checks apply.

requirements.aspect: Stamp Contents conveys intent when Name insufficient
requirements.justification: The sufficiency of a stamp name cannot be judged by its mere presence.

requirements.aspect: Accessible Ink has Contents
requirements.justification: Nonempty Contents is checked; its description quality remains human review.

requirements.aspect: Popup excluded from the structure tree
requirements.justification: Native annotation binding and resolved parent checks reject structured Popup.

requirements.aspect: Dictionary FileAttachment specification has AFRelationship
requirements.justification: String file specifications remain equivalent to Unspecified and are not falsely rejected.

requirements.aspect: Sound/Movie absent
requirements.justification: The deprecated annotation check applies.

requirements.aspect: Screen has Contents
requirements.justification: Description presence is checked; media accessibility remains external.

requirements.aspect: Zero-size widget is artifact
requirements.justification: Both zero width and zero height trigger the mandatory artifact rule; Hidden alone does not.

requirements.aspect: PrinterMark is artifact
requirements.justification: A structured printer mark must be under Artifact.

requirements.aspect: TrapNet absent
requirements.justification: The deprecated annotation check applies.

requirements.aspect: Real Watermark follows markup rules
requirements.justification: A real Watermark requires Annot parent; arbitrary artifact Watermarks remain allowed.

requirements.aspect: One logical redaction grouped when geometry permits
requirements.justification: The author decides logical redaction boundaries and representability with QuadPoints.

requirements.aspect: Projection follows markup rules
requirements.justification: Native markup-role checks apply.

requirements.aspect: Accessible 3D/RichMedia have Contents
requirements.justification: Description presence is checked; media alternatives need external accessibility evidence.

requirements.aspect: Custom annotations retain general obligations
requirements.justification: Flags, descriptions, structural association and page tab order do not depend on known subtype enumeration.

requirements.aspect: Annotations occur in logical content order
requirements.justification: The graph preserves the author's order without pretending to infer correct semantics.

requirements.aspect: Annotation close association to relevant content
requirements.justification: Geometry and semantic applicability require rendered review.

requirements.aspect: Annotated pages have Tabs A/W/S
requirements.justification: Direct and indirect Tabs names are resolved.

requirements.aspect: Alternative descriptions use the correct mechanism
requirements.justification: Whether a description is needed depends on annotation purpose and context.

requirements.aspect: Alternative Contents equals enclosing Alt
requirements.justification: Decoded strings are compared; FreeText displayed Contents is not incorrectly treated as an alternate description.

requirements.aspect: Real widgets use Form with at most one widget
requirements.justification: Managed associations and per-Form counts are checked; artifacts are exempt.

requirements.aspect: XFA absent
requirements.justification: AcroForm XFA is rejected.

requirements.aspect: Widget context is sufficient using allowed sources
requirements.justification: T field name is not accepted as descriptive evidence; quality and completeness require review.

requirements.aspect: Widget/group real labels use Lbl in the appropriate group
requirements.justification: Presence of a direct Lbl is mechanically recognized; deciding which real content labels the field is semantic.

requirements.aspect: Unlabelled widget requires Contents
requirements.justification: A direct Form label or nonempty Contents is required; TU alone does not substitute.

requirements.aspect: Widget with AA has Contents
requirements.justification: A nonempty action description is required on the structured real widget.

requirements.aspect: Description enriches label and explains action intent
requirements.justification: Semantic sufficiency and nonredundancy cannot be established from mere strings.

requirements.aspect: Multi-widget fields each have sufficient context
requirements.justification: TU does not prove that each individual widget is understandable.

requirements.aspect: Read-only fields permitted
requirements.justification: Native fields retain the read-only flag without treating it as an audit failure.

requirements.aspect: Button Contents reflects CA intent
requirements.justification: Description and caption semantic equivalence require human review.

requirements.aspect: Pushbutton descriptions reflect all interaction appearances
requirements.justification: CA/RC/AC/I/RI/IX and TU intent are semantic and may include images.

requirements.aspect: Checkbox/radio context conforms to 8.10.2
requirements.justification: Export values are not substituted for descriptions; semantic context is reviewed.

requirements.aspect: Rich text RV requires plain V
requirements.justification: Explicit text fields and indirect V strings are checked.

requirements.aspect: RV and V textual equivalence for explicitly selected bounded native XML parsing
requirements.justification: WtPdfRichTextChecks with WtPdfXmlRichTextParser compares normalized simple XHTML paragraph/span content to inherited canonical V, including entities, Unicode and line endings; DTDs/entities and active content are rejected. It is an explicit ext-dom capability; unavailable or unsupported content remains pending, not a pass.

requirements.aspect: Opaque or unsupported rich-text textual semantics
requirements.justification: Unnormalized compressed RV streams, unsupported namespaces and CSS changing text/visibility need an explicitly selected richer parser or normalization. The default graph audit remains pending when no rich-text parser is selected.

requirements.aspect: Choice display text conveys intent
requirements.justification: Export values, display labels and field context need semantic review.

requirements.aspect: Mandatory signature-widget artifact flags
requirements.justification: The same invisible/NoView/zero-size artifact rules apply to signature widgets.

requirements.aspect: Legal location and appearance/metadata consistency
requirements.justification: Legal relevance, graphical alternatives and contradictory appearance content require application evidence and human review.

requirements.aspect: Noninteractive Form has PrintField Role
requirements.justification: Native Form without a direct widget requires explicit PrintField Role; standard domains validate values.

requirements.aspect: Appropriate printed field values and label/group context
requirements.justification: Whether content represents a form field and the adequate attributes/labels depend on author intent.

requirements.aspect: Document XMP has nonempty dc:title language alternative
requirements.justification: Typed language alternatives are inspected; opaque XML gets an explicit external finding.

requirements.aspect: dc:title reflects the document title
requirements.justification: Visible Title need not match metadata literally; meaning is reviewed by a person.

requirements.aspect: Accessible ViewerPreferences DisplayDocTitle true
requirements.justification: Direct and indirect true boolean values are accepted.

requirements.aspect: Long documents should have useful outlines/actions
requirements.justification: No arbitrary length threshold or synthetic bookmark semantics are imposed.

requirements.aspect: Page labels match perceived numbers and non-index numbering
requirements.justification: Perceived page numbers require rendered/user interpretation.

requirements.aspect: Article threads should follow logical order
requirements.justification: The author-selected sequence is preserved but semantic order is not inferred.

requirements.aspect: Actions permitted
requirements.justification: The PDF object model retains actions without executing them in PHP.

requirements.aspect: ECMAScript changes communicate accessibly
requirements.justification: The core does not execute scripts or emulate assistive technology.

requirements.aspect: Accessible URI IsMap has equivalent real-content functionality
requirements.justification: Presence of alternatives and equivalent interaction require content/application review.

requirements.aspect: Every EmbeddedFiles dictionary specification has Desc
requirements.justification: Name-tree traversal checks description presence and rejects repeated children/cycles.

requirements.aspect: Embedded file description conveys enough intent
requirements.justification: A present string does not prove descriptive adequacy.

requirements.aspect: Supplement/alternative representation uses suitable associations
requirements.justification: Identify the intended supplemental content and which structure it represents.

requirements.aspect: Native associated-file relationships and MIME declarations
requirements.justification: Generic AF validation checks explicitly constructed file relationships/discovery; no payload parsing is implied.

requirements.aspect: Informative declaration example
requirements.justification: Native declarations and ClaimData model the illustrated optional properties.

requirements.aspect: Informative layout examples
requirements.justification: Attribute objects represent values; semantic relevance remains content-specific.

requirements.aspect: Informative list examples
requirements.justification: Native ListNumbering, ContinuedList and ContinuedFrom checks correspond to normative 8.2.5.25.

requirements.aspect: Informative PrintField examples
requirements.justification: Native Role/checked/Desc attributes represent printed field facts; intent remains human review.

requirements.aspect: Informative table attributes
requirements.justification: Native span/Scope/Headers shape and own-table ID checks supplement normative 8.2.5.26.

requirements.aspect: Informative artifact attributes
